name: The Broadcast
tagline: Built for the last five minutes of a close game.
blurb: A room designed around the screen rather than one that happens to have them. Tiered sightlines, a sound system tuned for commentary, and a kitchen that stays open until the final whistle.
features: Group tables for eight or more
capacityNote: Seats up to 60 for watch parties

name: Harbour & Vine
tagline: Water on one side, the match on the other.
blurb: A long room with a heated terrace at one end and a wall of screens at the other. Quieter than most on this list, which is exactly why some people book it.
capacityNote: Seats up to 80 for watch parties

name: The Terminal
tagline: Forty taps under a very high ceiling.
blurb: A converted transit hall, all brick and steel, that gets genuinely loud when the game is tight. The biggest room we work with and the easiest to get a large group into.
capacityNote: Seats up to 100 for watch parties

name: Court & Common
tagline: Low light, deep booths, serious cocktails.
blurb: The most comfortable room on the list. Leather booths, a projector wall that makes a midweek fixture feel like an occasion, and the best drinks programme we work with.
capacityNote: Seats up to 50 for watch parties

name: Grandstand Hall
tagline: The loudest room we book, deliberately.
blurb: Tiered seating, a proper sound rig, and a crowd that turns up in colours. If you want the closest thing to being in the stadium without the ticket price, this is it.
capacityNote: Seats up to 120 for watch parties

name: The Lamplighter
tagline: A neighbourhood room that fills up anyway.
blurb: The kind of place where the bartender remembers your order by the second visit. Unpretentious, comfortable, and packed every time there is anything worth watching.
capacityNote: Seats up to 70 for watch parties
